name: Arroba de los Montes (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arroba de los Montes (bees and a star on white above a castle).
history: Municipal flag of Arroba de los Montes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arroba de los Montes arms — bees, star and castle
